correctness.rationale: For finite p, the weak-p norm for E=ell1^n is the max column p-energy; its sum is at most n, while a full scaled transitive G orbit of a maximizing dual unit vector attains n in every coordinate budget. The p=infinity endpoint is the free AM norm. The finite-dimensional continuous homogeneous representation supplies surjectivity and positivity. The projection is a norm-one group average, not falsely asserted to be a lattice homomorphism. Exact disjoint-function witnesses prove non-AM ambient structure for each finite p. Rational tests support only finite cases.

value.rationale: An exact all-dimensions, all-exponents, all-transitive-groups isometric classification of a natural fixed-point lattice, not merely an isolated constant or reparameterization. The fixed-point space has the AM property even though the ambient free p-convex lattice fails it for every finite p. Exact order-statistic norms and a positive norm-one projection are concrete consequences.
